calculation.description: Cross-sectional negative 20-trading-day return divided by lagged 20-day daily volatility, activated when the mean cross-asset 20-day volatility is below its trailing 120-day 60th percentile. All inputs are lagged at the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive full-period IC and ICIR across the available online-era sample. Subperiod IC/ICIR: 2025-2026 unavailable before the synthetic online data start; 2025-2026 reported proxy segment 108 dates IC 0.06660, ICIR 0.22787; 2027-2028 327 dates IC 0.03383, ICIR 0.11878; 2028-09-01 to 2029-06-04 98 dates IC 0.01790, ICIR 0.05788. Recent drift is weaker than the full sample and should be monitored conservatively. High correlation with existing low-dispersion reversal artifacts indicates redundancy.
